label.zh: AI / 全栈工程师 · LLM / RAG · 计算机视觉

name.zh: 计算机视觉 / 工业 AI

position.zh: AI 与计算机视觉工程师

highlights.en: Led a real-time industrial vision system: **DeepStream + YOLO + TensorRT** multi-stream video inference with **32 concurrent RTSP feeds**, covering helmet / reflective-vest / safety-belt / smoking detection.
highlights.zh: 主导实时工业视觉系统：**DeepStream + YOLO + TensorRT** 多路视频推理，**32 路 RTSP 并发**，覆盖安全帽 / 反光衣 / 安全带 / 吸烟检测。

highlights.en: Designed a **two-stage vision architecture** (full-frame detection + secondary classification / detection) with dynamic batching, frame sampling and **TensorRT FP16** to optimize throughput; added consecutive-frame confirmation, alert cooldown and evidence-frame mechanisms that turn single-frame detections into stable event alerts delivered over Webhook / RTSP, with an architecture ready to **scale to 100+ streams**.
highlights.zh: 设计**两阶段视觉检测架构**（整帧检测 + 二级分类 / 检测），结合动态 Batch、抽帧与 **TensorRT FP16** 优化吞吐；配套连续帧确认、告警冷却与证据帧机制，将单帧检测转换为稳定事件告警并以 Webhook / RTSP 输出，架构具备向**百路级扩展**的基础。

highlights.en: Built a **PyTorch → ONNX → TensorRT** automated build and deployment pipeline and completed camera calibration with pixel-to-physical coordinate mapping; all services run in Docker on a **Linux GPU server (4 × NVIDIA L20)**, plus in-house data-collection tooling closing the data-to-deployment loop.
highlights.zh: 搭建 **PyTorch → ONNX → TensorRT** 自动化构建与部署流程，完成相机标定与像素—物理坐标映射；所有服务以 Docker 形式托管于 **Linux GPU 服务器（4 × NVIDIA L20）**，并开发内部数据采集工具，打通数据到部署的迭代闭环。

highlights.en: Took an education SaaS from half-finished to production: full-stack development in React / TypeScript, core feature delivery and system integration.
highlights.zh: 主导教育 SaaS 从半成品到生产上线：React / TypeScript 全栈开发，核心功能交付与系统集成。

highlights.en: Refactored the API layer with Prisma + tRPC, and automated deployment with Docker + Git Hooks.
highlights.zh: 用 Prisma + tRPC 重构 API 层，Docker + Git Hooks 实现自动部署。

highlights.en: Built an agent that orchestrates inquiry-based learning using the Llama LLM and n8n workflows.
highlights.zh: 基于 Llama 大模型及 n8n 工作流编排智能代理，构建学生自主探究式学习系统。

highlights.en: Contributed to the [Global EV Data Initiative](https://pzq123456.github.io/EVChargerSite/): multi-source cleaning, spatial processing and web visualization of global EV charging-station data, building a dynamic geospatial dashboard.
highlights.zh: 参与 [Global EV Data Initiative](https://pzq123456.github.io/EVChargerSite/)，负责全球 EV 充电站多源数据清洗、空间处理与 Web 可视化，构建动态地理信息仪表盘。

highlights.en: A **two-stage real-time inference pipeline** built on DeepStream with **32 concurrent RTSP streams** (dynamic batching + frame sampling + TensorRT FP16), designed to **scale to 100+ streams**; planar-homography camera calibration with pixel-to-physical mapping reusable for packaging-line visual inspection; containerized with Docker and automated model builds.
highlights.zh: 基于 DeepStream 的**两阶段实时推理管线**，**32 路 RTSP 并发**（动态 Batch + 抽帧 + TensorRT FP16），面向**百路级扩展**；平面单应性相机标定 + 像素—物理坐标映射，可复用于封装产线视觉检测；Docker 容器化部署，模型自动构建。

highlights.en: Enterprise document QA pipeline: Word / PDF → Markdown → embedding → retrieval → answer (BGE-M3 + Qdrant + Qwen).
highlights.zh: 企业文档问答链路：Word / PDF → Markdown → 向量化 → 检索 → 问答（BGE-M3 + Qdrant + Qwen）。

highlights.en: Split into three services by compute profile: a GPU-resident TEI embedding service, a stateless FastAPI QA agent, and stateful Qdrant (persistent volume + snapshot recovery); each service restarts and scales independently (decoupled via environment variables) and is orchestrated with Docker Compose.
highlights.zh: 按计算特性拆为三服务：GPU 常驻的 TEI 向量化服务、无状态的 FastAPI 问答 Agent、有状态的 Qdrant（持久化卷 + 快照恢复）；各服务独立重启与扩缩容（环境变量解耦），Docker Compose 一键编排。

highlights.en: Pydantic AI agent orchestrating GIS tools (spatial queries, buffer analysis) to drive analysis from natural language, streaming status and results over SSE.
highlights.zh: Pydantic AI Agent 编排空间查询与缓冲区分析等 GIS Tools，自然语言驱动分析流程，SSE 流式推送状态与结果。

highlights.en: Real-time map visualization with Vue 3 + Deck.gl / MapLibre, GeoJSON overlays and Pinia state management.
highlights.zh: Vue 3 + Deck.gl / MapLibre 实时地图可视化，GeoJSON 上图，Pinia 状态管理。

name.zh: 二手房数据采集与清洗

highlights.en: Extended an open-source scraper via API reverse engineering to collect **60+ fields** (price, coordinates, …) from Lianjia listings, building reusable scraping and cleaning scripts.
highlights.zh: 基于开源爬虫二次开发：通过接口逆向采集链家二手房 **60+ 字段**（价格、经纬度等），构建可复用的数据采集与清洗脚本。

name.zh: 共享单车轨迹数据分析（毕业论文）

highlights.en: Cleaned and analyzed **100k+** bike trajectories against OSM road-network data, performing spatial joins and visualization for a thesis and thematic maps.
highlights.zh: 清洗并分析 **10 万级**骑行轨迹与 OSM 路网数据，完成空间连接与可视化，产出毕业论文与专题地图。

name.zh: EV 充电站数据可视化平台

highlights.en: Integrated and standardized multi-source global EV charging-station data; SHP → GeoJSON processing pipeline with an interactive distribution and statistics dashboard.
highlights.zh: 全球 EV 充电站多源数据整合与标准化，SHP → GeoJSON 处理管线，交互式分布与统计仪表盘。
